name: ted
description: It's 1993 and Ted the bear's moment of fame has passed, leaving him living with his best friend, 16-year-old John Bennett, who lives in a working-class Boston home with his parents and cousin. Ted may not be the best influence on John, but when it comes right down to it, he's willing to go out on a limb to help his friend and his family.

videos.title: Just Say Yes
videos.overview: When Matty makes Ted go to school with John, Ted immediately decides to get expelled.

videos.title: My Two Dads
videos.overview: Ted and John's plan to exact revenge on the school bully inadvertently puts them in a parental role. Matty agrees to get a colonoscopy… on one condition.

videos.title: Ejectile Dysfunction
videos.overview: Ted and John go to extraordinary lengths so that John can watch his first adult film. Matty and Susan's disappointing night out leads Susan to question their relationship.

videos.title: Subways, Bicycles and Automobiles
videos.overview: Ted's plan to spend Halloween with John is thwarted when Blaire forces him to be her designated driver for the night. Susan tries to cheer John up by finding him a new friend.

videos.title: Desperately Seeking Susan
videos.overview: Blaire convinces Matty and Susan to let Ted act as their marriage therapist. After the session, Ted, John and Blaire encourage Susan to pursue the career she abandoned long ago.

videos.title: Loud Night
videos.overview: Matty's unorthodox Christmas wish is granted, completely upending the Bennett family dynamic. A trip to church gets John and Ted wondering about Ted's miraculous origin.

videos.title: He's Gotta Have It
videos.overview: As the end of the school year approaches, Ted plots to help John lose his virginity after John learns he is the last virgin in school.

videos.title: Talk Dirty to Me
videos.overview: John and Ted use the school's phone to call a phone-sex hotline, leading to an investigation.

videos.title: Mrs. Robicheck
videos.overview: Ted starts a risky love affair with a married woman; Matty deals with erectile dysfunction.

videos.title: Dungeons & Dealers
videos.overview: John, Ted and Blaire must complete a drug dealer's Dungeons & Dragons campaign to score weed.

videos.title: The Mom's Bombed Rom-Com
videos.overview: Blaire's rom-com movie marathon annoys Matty; Ted and John double date with their elderly neighbor.

videos.title: The Sword in the Stoned
videos.overview: John and Ted audition for the school play; Matty and Susan get part-time jobs at Dunkin' Donuts.

videos.title: Roe v. Weed
videos.overview: Blaire finds herself navigating an unexpected pregnancy, leading to mixed reactions from the family.

videos.title: Susan Is the New Black
videos.overview: Susan takes the fall for John and Ted when a police officer finds their weed during a traffic stop.

videos.title: Fraudcast News
videos.overview: John and Ted create a fake newspaper to keep Matty from learning about the O.J. Simpson verdict.
